v1.75.7 (29 September 2025) |feed_title = 🧪 Modifiers & Trials ⚖️ |feed_color = Blue |previous_update = [[v1.74.0]] |next_update = [[v1.76.0]] }} ==Description== '''v1.75.0''' is the one hundred and twenty-seventh update to be released in Tower Defense Simulator, on the 24th of September 2025. It introduced [[Challenge Trials]], new [[Modifiers]], and brought changes to [[Mission Quests]] and [[Elevators]]. This update encompassed eight versions, the main v1.75.0 (released 24 September 2025) and seven minor updates, the v1.75.1 (released 24 September 2025), the v1.75.2 (released 24 September 2025), the v1.75.3 (released 24 September 2025), the v1.75.4 (released 24 September 2025), the v1.75.5 (released 25 September 2025), v1.75.6 (released 25 September 2025) and the v1.75.7 (released 29 September 2025). ==Additions== *[[Challenge Trials]] *[[Broke]] *[[Committed]] *[[Exploding Enemies]] *[[Flying Enemies]] *[[Fog]] *[[Glass]] *[[Healthy Enemies]] *[[Hidden Enemies]] *[[Inflation]] *[[Limitation Makes Creativity]] *[[Quarantine]] *[[Speedy Enemies]] *[[Playtime Rewards]] ==Changes & Bugfixes== *[[Medic]] nerfed. **Statistical changes: ***'''Base''' ****[[Firerate Buff]] decreased from 20% to 15%. ***'''Level 1''' ****Cost increased from {{Money|300}} to {{Money|500}}. *[[Golden Soldier]] buffed. **Statistical changes: ***'''Base''' ****Range increased from 14 to 18. ***'''Level 1''' ****Cost increased from {{Money|150}} to {{Money|250}}. ****Burst changed from 4 to 4 > 5. ****Burst cooldown changed from {{Tooltip|0.75 > 0.6|-0.15}} to {{Tooltip|0.75 > 0.5|-0.25}}. ***'''Level 2''' ****Range decreased from +3 to +2. ****Name changed from ''Better Aiming'' to ''Field Training''. ***'''Level 3''' ****Cost increased from {{Money|3,000}} to {{Money|5,750}}. ****Lead detection added. ****Burst cooldown changed from {{Tooltip|0.6 > 1.2|+0.6}} to {{Tooltip|0.5 > 0|-0.5}}. ****Name changed from ''Equipment Upgrades'' to ''Gilded Gear''. ***'''Level 4''' ****Range increased from +2 to +4. ****Cost increased from {{Money|12,000}} to {{Money|14,500}}. ****Firerate changed from {{Tooltip|0.1 > 0.083|-0.017}} to 0.1. ****Name changed from ''Deadliest's Soldier'' to ''Maximum Potential''. *[[Jailed Towers (Modifier)|Jailed Towers]] modifier icon changed. *[[Mission Quests]] are now all available at once instead of changing every day. *Updated [[Elevators]]. **Now asks the player for the player count. When selected, the number of players in the elevator cannot exceed the number selected. **[[Elevators]] now support the [[Party]] system. If a party leader enters an [[Elevators|Elevator]], all its members will teleport in the elevator with them. If a player in a [[Party]] tries to enter an [[Elevators|Elevator]] while not the leader, the game will not let them enter and neither would the other members and the host. **It is now possible to instantly activate elevators instead of having to wait 20 seconds for them to depart. **Small box containing map information at the bottom of the screen removed. *[[Challenge Maps]] are no longer playable in the main game. **They can still be played in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. *Lobby crate area moved underground, as it has been replaced by the modifiers area. *Updated UI for the top right buttons. *Updated loading screen. *Fixed [[Slime]] having an incorrect health statistic. *Fixed '''🦅 Eagle Screech''', '''🇺🇸 Rise for the Pledge!''', '''Raft Wars''' and '''The Little Medic''' [[Mission Quests]] still being available. :In '''v1.75.1''': *Enabled [[Skills]] in [[Challenge Trials]]. :In '''v1.75.2''': *Pop-up message when accepting a [[Playtime Rewards|Playtime Reward]] now displays the actual reward instead of the name of the chest. *Fixed [[PVP]] [[Matchmaking]] not working. :In '''v1.75.3''': *[[Playtime Rewards]] updated. **Now displays how many chests are given out. **Now has a button that shows reward pool of the chest. :In '''v1.75.4''': *[[Challenge Trials]] wave structure changed. *[[Challenge Trials]] health scaling updated. **Duo now has health scaling of 10%. **Trio health scaling increased from 20% to 25%. *Fixed only [[Speedy Enemies]] trial having [[Skills]] enabled. :In '''v1.75.5''': *Disabled the ability to toggle modifiers in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] and [[PVP]] modes. :In '''v1.75.6''': *[[Playtime Rewards]] reward pools nerfed. **'''Low Grade Chest''' ***{{Coins|50}} chance increased from 20% to 40%. ***1 [[Low Grade Crate]] chance decreased from 20% to 15%. ***1 [[Mid Grade Crate]] chance decreased from 15% to 4%. ***1 [[Blizzard Bomb]] chance decreased from 5% to 1%. **'''Mid Grade Chest''' ***{{Coins|Coins}} changed. ****Amount decreased from {{Coins|200}} to {{Coins|100}}. ****Chance increased from 20% to 40%. ***1 [[Mid Grade Crate]] chance decreased from 20% to 15%. ***1 [[High Grade Crate]] chance decreased from 15% to 4%. ***1 [[Nuke]] chance decreased from 5% to 1%. **'''High Grade Chest''' ***{{Coins|Coins}} changed. ****Amount decreased from {{Coins|400}} to {{Coins|200}}. ****Chance increased from 20% to 40%. ***{{TimeScaleTicket|Time Scale Ticket}} amount decreased from {{TimeScaleTicket|4}} to {{TimeScaleTicket|3}}. ***{{SpinTicket|Spin Ticket}} amount decreased from {{SpinTicket|4}} to {{SpinTicket|3}}. ***1 [[High Grade Crate]] chance decreased from 20% to 18%. ***1 [[Nuke]] chance decreased from 10% to 1%. ***1 [[Molten Monster (Consumable)|Molten Monster]] chance decreased from 10% to 1%. *[[Glass]] trial map changed from [[Mason Arch]] to [[Stained Temple]]. *Fixed [[Jailed Towers (Modifier)|Jailed Towers]] preventing the player from doing anything in a match. :In '''v1.75.7''': *Fixed [[Jailed Towers (Modifier)|Jailed Towers]] not being given out on triumph. *Fixed toggleable modifier menu displaying every modifier boost as 1x. *Fixed toggleable modifier menu displaying the trial name instead of the modifier name. ==Gallery== {{Gallery|Open = Yes| {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} v1.75Thumbnail.png GenericAutumnThumbnail.png GenericThumbnail173.png
